activity_summary: At dinner the penny loaf was a thumb short of the notch. The price was still a penny. Verbeke named Norwich and then stopped. You did not change the price, and you did not write a new figure.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Named the penny and the thumb, and told Verbeke to eat.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Set the loaf against the board and said the pot was not short.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Named Norwich, and said nothing further.

entities.name: a penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in A thumb short of the notch

facets.activity: Ate the short loaf at a penny

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A penny, and a thumb short of the notch.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I'm not marking a price that has not moved.
